title: "Palmer Penguins Dashboard"
author: "Shaylee Ferrer"
format: dashboard
---

```{r}
##install.packages("tidyverse")
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(palmerpenguins)

penguins <- penguins
```

# Page 1

## Row 1

```{r}
mass_by_island <- ggplot(data = penguins, aes(x = island, y = body_mass_g)) +
  geom_boxplot()

ggplotly(mass_by_island)
```

```{r}
bill_by_island <- ggplot(data = penguins, aes(island, bill_length_mm)) +
  geom_boxplot()

ggplotly(bill_by_island)
```

## Row 2 {.tabset}

```{r}
#| title: Flipper Length by Mass
ggplot(penguins, aes(body_mass_g, flipper_length_mm, color = species)) +
  geom_point()
```

```{r}
#| title: Bill Length by Mass
ggplot(penguins, aes(body_mass_g, bill_length_mm, color = species)) +
  geom_point()
```

# Data Table

THis dataset describes 344 penguins and comes form the palerpenguins package. There are 3 species of penguins that live on 3 different islands in the Palmer Archipelago.

```{r}
penguins <- penguins |>
  select(-c(year))

knitr::kable(penguins)
```
